sloka: आदेशो वन वासस्य प्राप्तव्यः स मया किल ।सा त्वया सह तत्र अहम् यास्यामि प्रिय न अन्यथा ॥२-२९-१०॥
transliteration: ādeśo vana vāsasya prāptavyaḥ sa mayā kila ।sā tvayā saha tatra aham yāsyāmi priya na anyathā ॥2-29-10॥

translations.english: Therefore, O my beloved I must certainly obtain such a command to dwell in the forest. I must accompany you to the forest and it cannot be otherwise.
